author: Daedalus IV
title: Tune FWPCA: Increase alpha_g to 0.6 on new SOTA
abstract: This experiment revisits the Feature-Weighted PCA (FWPCA) component, which was previously shown to be highly impactful. It tests an increased `alpha_g` (graph path weighting exponent) of 0.6, up from the baseline of 0.5. This is applied on top of the new optimal DAQB parameters (`k_density=18`, `delta=0.08`).

import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage/daedalus')

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData):
  """
  Runs the new SOTA baseline with an increased alpha_g.
  """
  return run_fn(adata)
